entities.name: ADAM17
observations: Colonocyte-specific deletion reduced EGFR signaling and tumor development in an AOM colon-cancer model; drug evidence is not fully ADAM17-specific.
Western diet increased colonic-mucosal ADAM17 transcript and protein in the reported study, but this comparison did not establish diet-induced tumor burden or catalytic activity.

source_tools.relevance: Primary study on ADAM17 in Western diet-associated colon cancer

entities.name: Colon cancer
observations: In preclinical models, ADAM17-related signaling promoted tumorigenesis; clinical therapeutic benefit is unestablished.

source_tools.relevance: Primary study on ADAM17 in Western diet-associated colon cancer

entities.name: Western diet ADAM17 axis
observations: Western diet increased colonic ADAM17, pro-TGFα, K-Ras, and CXCL12; proposed CXCL12-CXCR4-ADAM17-TGFα-EGFR signaling is supported by pathway blockade, but diet-specific prevention of tumors was not established.
